notes: Starting prices in US$ per GPU-hour, read 18 Nov 2026. The router replaces them with live prices and stock where the cloud has a price API (live_prices).
speed = rough speed for picture/video diffusion relative to an RTX 4090 (estimates, not benchmarks); replaced by Ibasho's own logged run times per model and GPU as runs happen.
startup_s = time before the job can start (machine start + model download), billed on pods.

clouds.name: RunPod (pods)
clouds.live_prices: GraphQL gpuTypes { securePrice communityPrice lowestPrice { uninterruptablePrice stockStatus } } (needs the key)
clouds.note: Community prices; secure cloud costs more (4090 $0.89, H100 $2.89+). Already used by the studio.

clouds.name: RunPod (serverless)
clouds.note: Costs more an hour but bills only while working; best for short jobs.

clouds.name: Vast.ai (marketplace)
clouds.note: Often cheapest; machines are other people's, so reliability varies.

clouds.name: Modal (serverless)
clouds.billing: per second; loading and idle billed; $30 free a month
clouds.note: Cleanest serverless; the free $30 a month covers small users.

clouds.name: Salad (consumer GPUs)
clouds.note: Cheapest 4090/5090 but can be interrupted; later.

clouds.name: Koyeb (serverless)
clouds.billing: per second, scales to zero; needs the $29/month Pro plan

rule.fit: keep GPUs with vram >= the model's need x 1.15; drop out-of-stock offers and models the person's region forbids
rule.cheapest: lowest total cost of the job (not the lowest hourly price)
rule.default: the fastest choice costing no more than 1.5x the cheapest (studio rule: +$1-2/h is fine if it halves the time)
